title: Tunisian Shrimp Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Tunisia, made with succulent shrimp, rich tagine paste, and exotic spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the tagine paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Add the kapi, cumin, coriander, and salt. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve over couscous.
